free_tier.stated: The free tier covers static sites only: 'Static sites - Free - Your first 3 static sites - Git deployments - Unlimited bandwidth'. Application hosting starts at 'USD 6/ month, from - 1 GB RAM / 1 vCPU on XS'. Hourly rates cap at a monthly maximum: XS 'USD 0.008' an hour and 'USD 6' a month, S 2 GB USD 18, M 4 GB USD 36, L 8 GB USD 69, XL 16 GB USD 120.

chaining: the per-second rate capped at a monthly maximum makes this a burst host: an hour of the 8 vCPU / 8 GB L box costs USD 0.092 and a full month costs USD 69, so an afternoon job is billed in cents.
limits_note: the free tier carries no compute, so the first wall is the USD 6 monthly minimum.

identity_cost.detail: a card is required even for the free tier: the pricing page states "Account verification requires a credit or debit card, including for free sites. Prepaid cards are not accepted.", so a debit card is accepted and a prepaid card is rejected. The record does not state whether the card is charged or authorised for any amount at verification, whether a hold is placed, or whether an email address is also required
